name: Feather Token (Bird)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Use
powers.text: Toss it 5 ft into the air: it becomes a Roc that carries you and the party far (a journey takes half the time today).

summary: Toss it 5 ft into the air: it becomes a Roc that carries you and the party far (a journey takes half the time today).
text: This object looks like a feather. Different types of feather tokens exist, each with a different single-use effect. This one is a bird token. Toss it 5 ft into the air: it becomes a Roc that carries you and the party far (a journey takes half the time today).
